fix(web): keep the drop highlight while a drag crosses the zone's children

dragleave bubbles from the paragraph and buttons, so moving a dragged
file between them cleared the highlight until the next dragover.
Count dragenter/dragleave instead, clearing only at depth zero and on
drop (relatedTarget is null in Safari, so it can't be used). Tests
cover a child-to-child transition and a drop resetting the count.

fix(web): close gaps in the build guard found in review

- Reject duplicate CSP directives: browsers enforce the first copy, so
  a permissive directive could hide before a strict one.
- Reject any '! header' rule that detaches the CSP or another required
  header, and a required header set twice in one rule.
- Flag eval wherever it appears (window.eval, globalThis.eval,
  (0, eval)) and Function( with or without new.
- Check every srcset/imagesrcset candidate, plus formaction and ping.
- Report diagnostic paths with forward slashes on every platform.
